# HR Utils

## Summary
Three small helpers the HR cards share: `daysBetween(from, to = now)` for tenure, time-in-stage and days-open counts; `liveCount(links)` for how many entries of a linksToMany are actually present; and `formatMoney(n, { compact })` for salary figures (`$85,000`, or `$85k` in tight slots — compact only kicks in at 1,000 so an hourly rate never reads `$0k`).

## Usage
```ts
import { daysBetween, liveCount } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/hr/utils';

daysBetween(candidate.appliedDate); // days in pipeline
liveCount(meeting.interviewers);
```

## Non-goals
Anything HR-specific in shape: these are date and link arithmetic only.
